subject.title: [Bug]: Slack reaction_added/reaction_removed events never delivered via Socket Mode (multi-account, v2026.3.24)

question: Should maintainers keep this issue as the canonical reaction-specific live Slack diagnosis, or fold it into a broader Slack Socket Mode delivery investigation?
rationale: The source supports handler-level reaction routing, but the reported failure happens before any visible OpenClaw handler/log activity, so resolving it safely needs maintainer-owned live Slack evidence or an explicit consolidation decision.

options.title: Keep Reaction-Specific Canonical
options.body: Keep this issue open for redacted current-main reaction envelope and gateway trace proof before any fix is attempted.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Socket Mode Report
options.body: Move the reaction details under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/89222 only if maintainers want one broader Slack Socket Mode delivery thread despite the thinner public evidence there.

options.title: Close After Live Pass Proof
options.body: Close only if a maintainer can show current main receiving and routing reaction add/remove events in an equivalent multi-account Slack workspace.

recommendation.title: Keep Reaction-Specific Canonical
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for redacted current-main reaction envelope and gateway trace proof before any fix is attempted.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest history owner for the Slack monitor and mismatch-filter boundary that needs live evidence before code changes.
